def create_grid(x: Float[Array, '16']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    N = x.shape[0]
    bprobe_v0 = np.zeros((N, N, 3))
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
    z = bprobe_v0
    bprobe_v1 = x.reshape(-1, 1)
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v1))
    z[:, :, 0] = bprobe_v1
    z[:, :, 1] = x
    bprobe_v2 = z.reshape(N * N, 3)
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v2))
    fast_grid = bprobe_v2
    return bprobe_trace
